about: Thompson is a city in northern Manitoba, in the boreal forest of the Canadian Shield north of Lake Winnipeg. Nickel mining built the town; it remains a regional hub for the North, First Nations communities, and winter roads toward Hudson Bay country. About 13,000 people live in Thompson.
seoSummary: Northern Manitoba Shield city—nickel-mining hub and service centre for the boreal North.
knownFor: Gateway to Hudson Bay and northern communities
